topic: K-Stick and the Map That Keeps Changing Its Mind
hook_text: K-Stick finally found a map... probably.
background: Simple park path with one bench, a signpost, and a reusable pale-blue sky background
main_expression: Confident smile turning into wide-eyed confusion, then a proud grin
main_pose: Standing with one hand holding an unfolded map and the other pointing dramatically toward the path
prop: A simple folded paper map with a red location marker
scene_1: K-Stick unfolds the map, spots the red marker, and confidently points down the path as if he knows exactly where he is going.
scene_2: He takes two steps, but the map suddenly flips its arrow around. K-Stick spins in place, following the new direction while his eyes grow wider.
scene_3: The map changes again and points directly at K-Stick. He looks behind himself, expecting a destination, but finds nothing.
twist_ending: K-Stick proudly taps the map and says, "Found it!" The map reveals a tiny label on his cap reading "You are here," so he has been the destination the whole time.
video_title: K-Stick and the Map That Keeps Changing Its Mind
facebook_caption: When your map has no idea where you are... but still blames you. 🗺️😂
youtube_description: K-Stick follows a very confident map that keeps changing directions. The final destination is much closer than he expected!
image_prompt: A clean 2D family-friendly stickman cartoon frame featuring K-Stick, a simple black stickman with a round white face, huge expressive eyes, and a signature red cap. He stands on a simple park path beside a bench and signpost, holding an oversized folded paper map with a red marker and a changing arrow. Minimal reusable background, bold black outlines, bright flat colors, playful comedy style, no text except tiny optional map labels, no crowd, no copyrighted characters.
motion_prompt: 15-second simple 2D animation with quick comedic timing. Seconds 0-3: K-Stick unfolds the map, smiles confidently, and points down the path. Seconds 3-8: he walks two steps as the map arrow flips direction; he spins around with increasingly confused eyes. Seconds 8-11: the arrow flips again and points directly at him; he slowly looks behind himself. Seconds 11-15: he grins proudly and taps the map, then the map zooms slightly to reveal 'You are here' printed on his red cap. Add a quick record-scratch sound, light paper-flip sounds, and a cheerful comedic sting at the ending.
